observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor school gymnasium or dance studio with wooden wall bars and banner in background
observation.formation_and_space: solo dancer moving laterally and turning in place
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees, weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: stepping side-to-side, tapping heels and crossing feet on beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held out to sides at shoulder height with elbows slightly bent and fists clenched
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso movement, upper body relatively still while stepping
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing level, low turns, no jumps
observation.costume_and_props: black t-shirt with multicolored logo, black trousers or leggings, athletic sneakers
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot pressure and precise timing details due to camera framing and stationary angle

signature_moments.what: stepping sideways with heel taps while holding arms extended at shoulder height
traveling step pattern moving towards the side of the room
